faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Spices Board Sample Receipt Desk Trainee recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Sample Receipt Desk Trainee position at Spices Board is October 6, 2026. Ensure you complete the process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this training?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University or Institute. Additionally, computer knowledge is a mandatory requirement for this role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Sample Receipt Desk Trainee post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Sample Receipt Desk Trainee position is 30 years, calculated as of the date of the written test.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Sample Receipt Desk Trainee position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Sample Receipt Desk Trainee role will receive a stipend of Rs. 20,000/- per month during the training period.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Sample Receipt Desk Trainee post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Sample Receipt Desk Trainee position in the Spices Board recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Sample Receipt Desk Trainee post primarily involves a written test. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in this examination.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for this recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Spices Board Regional Office located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Spices Board, Regional Office located in Bangalore, Karnataka, with the pincode 560056.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Sample Receipt Desk Trainee position is a training program, offering an opportunity to gain experience in the field.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any state apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: While the notification mentions Karnataka, it is always best to refer to the official notification for specific eligibility regarding domicile or state of application.
